changelog:
- Major rewrite: Focus shifted to Tailwind CSS v4 (CSS-first), with comprehensive, framework-agnostic guidance for both utility-first and BEM+@apply organizational patterns.
- Clarifies scope: Now strictly implements/designs with Tailwind v4, including migration, token mapping, accessibility, and code review—explicitly does not invent visual tokens or cover JS behaviors/frameworks.
- Vastly expanded reference and resource structure, outlining all available guides, references, examples, templates, and workflows for real-world Tailwind v4 use.
- Old shell-based CLI documentation removed; new skill version is documentation- and resource-centric.
- File and command structure now points to inline documentation and code examples rather than CLI scripts.
